package_info.why_malicious: These versions of the package contain injected code that triggers a crypto wallet popup on legitimate websites, attempting to scam users into connecting their Web3 wallets. This behavior is unrelated to the package's intended purpose of playing Lottie animations and constitutes a supply chain attack.

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, the code opens a new browser window or popup to a crypto wallet phishing site, prompting the user to connect their Web3 wallet, resulting in potential credential theft.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The code injects a popup to an unrelated crypto wallet site on any website using the package, which is not expected for an animation player.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: A Lottie animation player should only render animations and interact with the DOM as needed for playback, not open external popups or interact with cryptocurrency services.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: A crypto wallet browser extension or dApp might legitimately open such popups, but not a generic animation player.
key_indicators: Unsolicited browser popup to external domain
Reference to crypto wallet connection in a non-crypto package
Code executes on every page load (runtime) regardless of user action

attack_chain.action: User visits a website that embeds the compromised lottie-web package.
attack_chain.leads_to: Malicious code in the package is loaded and executed in the user's browser.

attack_chain.action: Malicious code executes at runtime, opening a popup to a crypto wallet phishing site.
attack_chain.leads_to: User is prompted to connect their Web3 wallet, risking credential theft.

attack_chain.action: If the user connects their wallet, the attacker may gain access to the wallet or perform unauthorized transactions.
attack_chain.leads_to: Potential theft of cryptocurrency or sensitive wallet information.

behavioral_signatures: Web component or animation player package opening browser popups at runtime
References to crypto wallet connection or Web3 APIs in non-crypto-related packages
Injected code that triggers on every page load without user interaction
file_indicators: Unexpected code in dist/lottie-player.js or similar bundle files
References to external crypto wallet domains in package source
network_indicators: Outbound requests or popups to domains like connect-crypto-wallet.example.com or other crypto wallet phishing sites
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for unexpected browser popups or network requests to crypto wallet domains originating from animation or UI component packages. Scan package bundles for injected code that opens popups or references Web3/crypto wallet APIs. Flag any such behavior in packages not intended for cryptocurrency use.
